items.label: HIGH QUALITY
items.value: Couch covers is composed of 3 layers, Quilted texture, Water repellent, Comfort, Softness. Reversible two colors, double sides use.

items.label: DIMENSIONS
items.value: Couch Cover fit seat width up to 68 in, Please Measure Before Purchasing. See Measuring Guide in Photos.

items.label: FURNITURE PROTECTOR & REFRESH
items.value: Sofa covers not only protects your couch from daily wears and tears, spills and stains, fur from pets, dogs but also transforms an old, worn out couch into the stunning centerpiece of your living room. It's a great choice for homes with children and pets.

items.label: ANTI SLIP
items.value: Couch covers feature elastic straps to keep it stay in place. Longer over the arm and two foam rods which tucked into the grooves of sofa on two sides to stay in place better.

items.label: EASY TO INSTALL
items.value: Sofa covers just drape it on, Tuck any extra fabric into the gap/crease and insert the non slip foam between the Arm and sitting cushions for a seamless look, adjust the elastic straps.

items.label: EASY CARE
items.value: Machine Washable Couch covers, wash at or below 30 degrees Celsius, do not bleach, do not iron.
